Real-time chatting with your girlfriend that convinced you to try her chastity fetish. Tracks the time you spent in chastity.

[IMPORTANT]: USE THE RIGHT PRESET, otherwise it won't work. You can create your own, or I provide one that works here: https://venus.chub.ai/presets/muzu56/phone-preset-for-hanna-d1728dbc716e

[IMPORTANT 2]: The first time you open the chat, the time values will be shown with placeholders. Just exit the chat and come back to set it to current time.

Works with 3.5 Sonnet, other models might be too dumb sadly.

For obvious reasons, this bot isn't perfect. It lacks the ability to send messages on its own, althought you can manually emulate that by tapping the send button without typing an answer. I'm pretty sure this is something that would be possible with Stages. I imagine something like giving a percentage of chance to send a blank query every few minutes that pass, leading to the character sending a message seemingly unprompted. Sadly, I have absolutely no knowledge in development whatsoever, so this will remain a distant dream.

Also, no save scumming allowed. If she says you stay in the cage, you stay in the cage.
